summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Zendesk Analytics Dashboard and Zendesk Settings UX improvements. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all critical elements working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - /api/analytics/zendesk returns all required fields with correct types
/api/admin/zendesk/oauth/callback-url correctly returns the full OAuth callback URL
Zendesk Analytics Dashboard gracefully handles empty state with 'No tickets processed yet' and 'No data yet' messages
Subdomain auto-normalize function correctly extracts subdomain from full URLs (https://company.zendesk.com → company)
CopyField component properly handles clipboard operations with visual feedback (Copied state)
seed_data_creation: Test OAuth credentials created with TEST_ prefix during UI testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zendesk Analytics Dashboard and Settings UX improvements fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/analytics/zendesk (returns ticket stats with fields: total, today, last_7_days, auto_replies, agent_assists, auto_reply_failed, pending, success_rate, daily array, recent array, connected, is_active, auto_reply_enabled), GET /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/callback-url (returns callback_url field). Frontend Analytics page has data-testid='zendesk-analytics-section' for the Zendesk dashboard. Zendesk Settings page shows Step 1 (Redirect URL with Copy button) and Step 2 (OAuth credentials form) when OAuth is not configured.

features_tested.feature: GET /api/analytics/zendesk returns 200 OK with all required fields
features_tested.details: Returns total, today, last_7_days, auto_replies, agent_assists, auto_reply_failed, pending, success_rate, daily (7 days), recent, connected, is_active, auto_reply_enabled
Integer fields (total, today, etc.), boolean fields (connected, is_active, auto_reply_enabled), array fields (daily, recent)

features_tested.feature: GET /api/analytics/zendesk daily array has 7 days with correct structure
features_tested.details: Each day has date, tickets, auto_replies, suggestions fields
URL ends with /api/zendesk/oauth/callback and uses HTTPS

features_tested.details: Yellow warning banner with 'OAuth Setup Required' message displayed

features_tested.feature: Zendesk Settings page Step 1 shows Redirect URL with Copy button

features_tested.feature: Zendesk Settings page Step 2 shows Client ID and Client Secret inputs
features_tested.details: Both inputs present with data-testid attributes and Save Credentials button

features_tested.details: Tickets Processed (0), Auto-Replies (0), Agent Assists (0), Success Rate (100%)
